method: For each scalar metric, compute one selected shortest-path tree from s and one selected shortest-path tree to t on the reversed directed graph, scan additive via profiles for all vertices, and reconstruct only profile-feasible concatenations.
road_id_mode: normal vertex-state Dijkstra; road_id only breaks exact scalar ties
box_center_score: ranking-only Chebyshev distance to L/H box centers and diagnostic Paris-style popularity/width pseudo-centers P in [Pmin,255], W in [5,Wmax]; never used for pruning
